title: Mamata’s most trusted aide Sudip Bandyopadhyay may join camp of rebel Trinamool MPs
description: Sudip Bandyopadhyay’s visit to Delhi and meeting with Union Minister Bhupendra Yadav comes days before rebel Trinamool MPs are going to meet the Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla and stake claim as an independent group backing the Bharatiya Janata Party led National Democratic Alliance government at the Centre
